points.text: Angle matrix feeding NAB has no formula.
Objective/cost per task undefined.
Demand and time-window generation undefined.
OOD-cluster construction missing.
How duration enters the model is unclear.
Claim of better computational efficiency contradicted; slower than POMO.
'Single unified framework' not shown by a single trained model.
State-of-the-art holds only among listed baselines, not under matched training.
Ablation only in a figure without numeric table or error bars; 15% unverifiable.
No AAFM vs standard attention ablation.
City size counts in text disagree with Table 4.
Text says times in parentheses but Table 1 uses separate column.
Duplicate entries in reference list.
Inconsistent module naming typos.
Method novelty incremental: MatNet embeddings, AAFM, standard gating.
Nearest ancestors (heuristic-bias AAFM, ReLD) not baselines or ablations.
'Real-world' narrower than framed: small windows, n=100, synthetic demands.
Asymmetry attributed to traffic but no traffic data used.
Asymmetry and non-metricity of matrices never quantified.
Related-work claims about inefficiency of prior edge-aware NCO unsupported.
Citation errors: OR-Tools entry, unrelated traffic citation, duplicates, weak haversine source.
Baselines not retrained on same data; Table 1 does not isolate edge encoding.
No seeds, repeated runs or variance reported.
Ablations do not isolate encoder, decoder, NAB vs heuristic bias, k, log-dist term.
In-distribution test instances share point pools with training.
Classical solver timing settings (instances, threads, limits) not stated.
No time-matched quality comparison with anytime classical solvers.
Cost objective per task not stated.
Demand, capacity and time-window generation not stated.
OOD-cluster instance construction not stated.
Normalization strategy for unreachable destinations not described.
How durations enter the model not described.
Angle matrix of NAB has no formula.
Only n=100 instances; no larger sizes despite large-scale motivation.
No external real-world benchmark evaluation.
Efficiency claim contradicted by Table 1 times.
City counts in text vs Table 4 inconsistent.
MatNet and other baselines absent from ACVRPTW block.
'Single unified framework' claim while models trained per task.
Uniform static instances ignore clustered demand and time-dependent travel times.
Asymmetry framed as traffic effect though traffic deferred.
OSM data quality across regions not discussed.
Dataset licence and OSM attribution not stated.
Whether distance or duration is minimized not stated per task.
Broader-impact claims rhetorical; market forecast presented as fact.
Baselines trained differently; SOTA comparison uncontrolled.
MatNet absent from ACVRPTW.
Gains not attributable to gating/NAB; ablation internal only.
'Real-world' traffic framing but only static matrices in small windows.
No asymmetry statistics reported.
In-distribution test shares point pools with training.
Single run, no seeds or variance.
SOTA, efficiency and unified-framework wording overclaims.
Market size forecast presented as fact.
Citation errors for OR-Tools and traffic forecasting.
Population counts inconsistent.
Inference-time parentheses statement mismatches Table 1.
Unclear if module handles shared contextual features like time of day or weather.
Limited theoretical novelty; built from existing attention and gating.
No robustness evaluation under dynamic or stochastic traffic conditions.
Angle matrix computation not defined.
Runtime parameters and time limits of traditional solvers unspecified.
Dynamic features per problem type unspecified.
Decoder uses only last-node embedding without justification.
No granular ablation of NAB inputs (distance, duration, angle).
Works underlying encoder and decoder not included as baselines.
Typos and naming inconsistencies; undefined hyperparameter; duplicated equation.
'Real-world VRP' defined narrowly as asymmetric costs only.
OR-Tools missing from ATSP comparisons.
Computation-time protocol for baselines unclear.
No results on established benchmarks.

P.summary: Ablation results not tabulated; claims unverifiable.
Ablations fail to isolate components vs ancestors (AAFM, heuristic bias, ReLD decoder).
'Real-world' framing overstated: static, small, synthetic, no traffic.
Baselines not retrained on same data.
No time-matched comparison with classical solvers.
Market forecast presented as fact; rhetorical impact.

Q.summary: Handling of shared contextual features unclear.
Real-world definition narrow; no dynamic traffic robustness.
Classical solver settings and timing protocol unclear.
